index.description: L2 index of fragment packs. A fragment is one role prompt a recipe composes; recipes address it as corpus:<name>, and the name is the file basename, flat across the whole tree. The retriever reads this after routing to the composable layer, picks the packs it needs, and only then opens a fragment body. One meta.json per pack gates every fragment beneath it. Authoring rules: fragments/AGENTS.md.

pack.summary: Article-pipeline role fragments: six composable prompt bodies plus one output schema (corpus:article-outliner et al.), distilled from workflows/article-pipeline.js for the F027 workflow composer. The verification-gate trio moved to fragments/gate/ so solo-tier recipes can gate too.

Research-first build fragments: one parameterised research cataloger reused per axis, a quantified concept synthesizer plus its verdict schema, a solution designer that turns the chosen concept into an SDD spec, and an asset director (corpus:build-domain-cataloger et al.). Generalised from the g5 research-first pipeline for the F027 workflow composer.

Verification-gate fragments: the bootstrap that makes a gate runnable, the runner that executes a project's validation commands into a {clean, findings} verdict, its schema, and the fixer the gate loop repairs with (corpus:gate-bootstrap, corpus:gate-runner, corpus:gate-fixer). Tier solo because every gated recipe needs them, including the solo ones.

Research fragments that make the corpus demand the fetch instead of substituting for it: research-source-discipline (the shared block every research role includes — load-bearing definition, URL plus access date, H/M/L confidence, recency, the no-reliable-figure path, the recalled-not-verified label, faion fact add provenance), research-market-analyst (competitor breadth floors and a mandatory debunk pass), research-evidence-table (the output contract, gated by the source-table tool) and research-desk-brief (question to executable search plan). Tier solo so it matches the research tool pack it invokes.

SDD role fragments: six composable prompt bodies plus three output schemas (corpus:sdd-intake-analyzer et al.), distilled from the sdd-batch-orchestrator workflow's role contracts for the F027 workflow composer. The planner schema is what a recipe fans out over.

The second-pass instruction `faion search` emits when its own coverage is below strong (corpus:search-refine). Tier free deliberately: a gated refine block would mean a free user cannot use the search loop at all, which would make the cheapest tier the worst-behaved one.
